title: Adult Courses & Retreats
tagline: Immersive creative writing and poetry retreats in the tranquil surroundings of Colligan, Co. Waterford.
intro: Designed for emerging and experienced adult writers alike, Clodagh’s courses and full-day retreats combine close reading of contemporary poetry, generative writing exercises, and supportive seminar-style workshopping in an intimate, capped group setting.

items.title: Creative Writing & Poetry Full-Day Retreat

advert.heading: CREATIVE WRITING FULL-DAY RETREAT
advert.date: Spring / Autumn Seasonal Dates (Enquire for Next Available Date)
advert.venue: Colligan Falls, Dungarvan, Co. Waterford (X35 YC66)
advert.time: 9:30 am (for a 10:00 am sharp start) to 5:00 pm
advert.notes: Tea, artisan coffee and home-cooked lunch included. Numbers strictly limited (capped at 7 participants).

items.longDescription: Step away from daily demands for a restorative day of reading, writing, and conversation beside the Colligan River. With over 16 years of experience teaching adults, university students, and writers, Clodagh guides participants through carefully curated prompts and contemporary texts to unlock new poems and sharpen editorial instincts.
bullets: Generate fresh drafts through structured morning writing prompts and sensory exercises
Close-read landmark contemporary poems from Ireland, the UK, and America
Workshop work-in-progress in a warm, constructive group (strictly capped at 7 writers)
Receive individual written follow-up notes and reading recommendations after the retreat

title: Poetry Workshops
tagline: Intensive craft-focused workshops for intermediate and advanced practicing poets.
intro: Focused masterclasses examining specific elements of poetic craft—from titles, opening lines, and stanzaic architecture to revision, compression, and preparing manuscripts for journal submission.

items.title: Full Day Poetry Workshop: “Titles & Opening Lines”

advert.heading: FULL DAY POETRY WORKSHOP
advert.venue: Colligan Falls, Dungarvan, Co. Waterford (X35 YC66)
advert.time: 9:30 am (for a 10 am sharp start) to 5 pm
advert.notes: Tea, Coffee and lunch included. Numbers strictly limited. (Group capped at 7 participants).

items.longDescription: SPECIAL FOCUS: TITLES & OPENING LINES. During this intensive one-day poetry workshop at Colligan Falls, participating poets will examine how a poem’s title and opening lines establish tension, voice, contract, and momentum—and apply these insights directly to their own manuscripts.
bullets: Have the opportunity to generate new work through targeted craft exercises
Interrogate and analyse the titles and opening lines of up to 20 specially selected contemporary poems
Workshop 2 poems each (poems max 40 lines must be submitted in a single Word document to Clodagh by 15th January, 2027)
Receive a 200-word emailed feedback from Clodagh following the workshop
Tea, Coffee and lunch included — numbers strictly capped at 7 participants

items.longDescription: A uniquely designed exam-focused and wellbeing course for Senior Cycle students covering Poetry (Prescribed & Unseen, Paper 2) and The Composition (Paper 1). Paper 2: PRESCRIBED & UNSEEN POETRY (Focus: ‘Seeing the Poem as a House’ — strengthen understanding, analysis, interpretation, personal response & quote recall)
Vocabulary Expansion, Student Wellbeing & Increased Exam Confidence across Higher and Ordinary Levels
Comprehensive printed handouts and study notes provided at each session; group numbers strictly limited for individual attention
